shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts && sed -n '1,170p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,210p' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "accepts the optional paging|conversationListValidation" specs .lore src | head -20 && test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs && echo reanchor-present || true && npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts && sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md && rg -n \"changelog\" .github scripts package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write CHANGELOG.md src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts --runInBand && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add CHANGELOG.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts && git commit -m "fix(transport): satisfy session list validation checks" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
